datasets.title: Astragalus leaves hyperspectral to root bioactive compounds
datasets.herb: 蒙古黄芪 / Astragalus membranaceus var. mongholicus
datasets.groups: 720 rows from15 plants; idnex=1..15, exactly48 rows per plant. Root target vector constant within each plant.
datasets.batches: Single Guyang study; collection conditions per paper, no independently verified multi-batch target domains
datasets.instruments: leaf mean spectrum204 bands397.32–1003.58nm, plus5 other tissue/background blocks
datasets.license: No LICENSE identified in source repository; local research evaluation; do not mirror raw workbook
datasets.caveat: 720 is leaf measurements, not720 independent roots. Split on15 plants, preserve all48 leaves of each plant in one partition. Do not import author loader random per-dataset splits or its split-specific scaling. Chemical labels are plant-level and insufficient for large-model claims.
